text: Check Smart Match right after reporting – a matching found item may already be listed.
Keep one unique detail private. DOSS uses it to confirm you are the real owner.
Adding a photo makes your report much easier to recognise.
Valuable items can be handed over at the DOSS Office, Administration Block.
Bring your student ID when collecting an item from DOSS.
Report quickly – most items are matched within 48 hours.
